title: Get guided to a Plan you can be confident in
statement: As an architect, I can use a guided wizard that does research and creates prototypes until I am confident in each Task's size, so I end with a Plan that is well understood rather than merely written down.

acceptance_criteria.statement: The wizard researches the feature and the existing code, and presents what it found.
The wizard can create prototypes as part of building that confidence.
The wizard names the Tasks it is not yet confident are two days or less, rather than reporting the Plan as ready.
